title: Isometric Grids, 3D Projections & Snapping
subtitle: Axonometric Grids, Isometric Studio, Fit-to-Plane & Snapping Candidates
description: Master parallel 3D vector illustration in Affinity Designer: configure axonometric and isometric grids in the Grid and Axis Manager, leverage the dedicated Isometric Studio with Front/Side/Top planes, perform non-destructive Fit-to-Plane projection for flat UI and typography, and lock vertices with precision snapping candidates.
prerequisites: D01: Designer Interface, Personas & Canvas Setup
D02: Vector Nodes, Paths & Pen Tool Geometry
D03: Advanced Shape Creation & Boolean Geometry
learningOutcomes: Configure custom axonometric and true 30° isometric grids using the Grid and Axis Manager.
Activate and navigate the Isometric Studio across Top, Side, and Front projection planes.
Project 2D flat typography, badges, and interface assets into 3D isometric space using Fit to Plane.
Draw and edit vector geometry directly inside projected planes using the Edit in Plane toggle.
Configure Snapping Candidates and Intersection Snapping to achieve pixel-perfect vertex joins without seam artifacts.

capstoneProject.title: Isometric Modular Server Terminal Kiosk
capstoneProject.description: Construct an architecturally accurate isometric server kiosk complete with multi-plane bevels, projected flat UI screens, and interlocking conduit cables locked to snapping candidates.
evaluationCriteria: Isometric grid configured at 30° angles with 64px major spacing and 16px subdivisions.
Coherent 3-value light model applied across Top (light), Side (midtone), and Front (shadow) planes.
Flat 2D UI elements accurately projected using Isometric Studio Fit-to-Plane.
